item.title: Ada Lovelace
item.description: Augusta Ada King, Countess of Lovelace was known for her work on the Analytical Engine. The general-purpose computer proposed by Charles Babbage. She was an English mathematician and writer. Born as the sole legitimate daughter of Lord Byron, the union of her parents was broken a month after her birth. item.title: Nonparametric Regression
item.description:
Methods for estimating regression functions without assuming a parametric form for the relationship between predictors and response. The function is estimated directly from data, with smoothness controlled by a bandwidth or tuning parameter rather than a fixed model. Covers kernel regression, local polynomial fitting, splines, and related approaches. Connects to density-estimation and smoothing-splines. See Also
